scope: All 28 personal, relative, interrogative and possessive source-tag L/H/W/X cards. Exact headword recall remains distinct from a one-word sentence blank. Alternative acceptance is authored per sentence, not inferred from form families.

corpes:que:H.reason: Book antecedent and no article before the blank require que.

corpes:se:L.reason: Herself with Ana fixes the reflexive object.

corpes:suyo:X.reason: Libro fixes masculine singular; hers fixes third-person possession.

corpes:lo:L.reason: Specify grammatical gender rather than rejecting a plausible feminine object silently.

corpes:le:L.reason: Give her a book identifies a singular recipient.

corpes:me:L.reason: Me as the person Ana sees requires the object form.

corpes:él:L.headwordCue: Subject / after a preposition · masculine singular
corpes:él:L.reason: He fixes masculine singular; ella changes meaning.

corpes:mío:X.reason: Libro and predicate position require mío, not mi or mía.

corpes:nos:L.reason: Us as the group Ana sees requires nos, not nosotros.

corpes:qué:W.reason: Both interrogatives can refer to the thing wanted here; cuál selects among contextual possibilities.
corpes:qué:W.answerNote: Qué can ask what to choose or want; cuál selects a thing from contextual possibilities. Both fit here.

corpes:yo:L.reason: I and sé fix first-person singular.

corpes:nuestro:X.reason: Nuestra agrees with casa; nuestro does not fit this blank.

corpes:quien:H.reason: Nadie is a person, with no article after con; quien fits the single-word blank.

corpes:tuyo:X.headwordCue: Possessive · long form · masculine singular · informal singular owner
corpes:tuyo:X.reason: Specify addressee; libro fixes masculine agreement and postnominal position excludes tu.

corpes:cual:H.headwordCue: Relative pronoun · used with an article
corpes:cual:H.reason: Both del cual and del que introduce the relative clause about punto.
corpes:cual:H.answerNote: Del cual and del que both fit this relative clause.

corpes:mí:L.reason: Para requires mí, not me or possessive mi.

corpes:usted:L.reason: Cue distinguishes formal you from plural ustedes and third-person references.

corpes:nosotros:L.headwordCue: Subject / after a preposition · masculine plural headword
corpes:nosotros:L.reason: English we does not specify group gender; both agree with aseguramos.
corpes:nosotros:L.answerNote: Nosotros and nosotras both fit; the English sentence does not specify the group’s gender.

corpes:cuyo:H.reason: Cuyo agrees with hijo, not mujer.

corpes:tú:L.reason: Puedes fixes tú in the taught tuteo pattern; cue avoids a regional-voseo inference.

corpes:quién:W.reason: Tiene is singular, so quiénes cannot fill this unchanged sentence.

corpes:sí:L.headwordCue: Reflexive · after a preposition · third person
corpes:sí:L.reason: Ella misma can refer reflexively to the woman taking the table; sí misma remains the recommended reflexive example.
corpes:sí:L.answerNote: Both sí misma and ella misma can refer to her doing it herself; sí is the usual reflexive form.

corpes:cuál:W.reason: Both interrogatives can identify the thing to choose; keep singular which one, not cuáles.
corpes:cuál:W.answerNote: Qué can ask what to choose or want; cuál selects a thing from contextual possibilities. Both fit here.

corpes:ti:L.reason: Specify treatment and tuteo; para requires ti, not object te.

corpes:conmigo:L.reason: Conmigo is the single word for with me; con mí is not standard.

corpes:os:L.headwordCue: Object / reflexive · informal plural in Spain
corpes:os:L.reason: Fix the vosotros variety and plural addressees; not te or les.
